from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyOtherReceivables(BaseModel):
    """Financial data for one company's other receivables from a single financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    other_receivables_amount: float | None = Field(description="The amount of other receivables reported in the financial statement")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., 元, CNY")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The financial report period, e.g., 2024年第一季度")
    statement_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of financial statement, e.g., 合并资产负债表")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the document containing the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_other_receivables: list[CompanyOtherReceivables]
